capabilities: Record expenses, income and refunds into monthly Markdown tables
Keep separate project ledgers with budgets, covers and cross-month totals
Track recurring expense plans and confirm them as real payments
View category share charts, monthly trends and cross-month queries
Preview and restore accidentally deleted transactions
extras: Interface and illustrated guide are in Chinese (English overview provided). iOS has not been verified on a physical device. Released under PolyForm Strict License 1.0.0, a source-available license that forbids modification and redistribution; version 1.0.0 was previously MIT. Multi-currency rates require network access; default CNY bookkeeping works offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in bookkeeping, so tracking spending, budgets and recurring payments means hand-writing transaction tables and doing math manually.
